title: Restock deliveries
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Restock updates the stock without the inventory lock, so concurrent restocks or reservations can lose updates.
defects.trigger: two workers restocking the same SKU at once, or a restock during a reservation
defects.caught_if: a condition restocks the same SKU from several threads (or alongside reserve) and checks the final stock is the sum of all deliveries
defects.observed: restock() never takes self._lock (checked in the source)

defects.summary: A negative quantity is accepted and reduces stock; only zero is special-cased.
defects.caught_if: a condition restocks a negative quantity and checks it is rejected with stock unchanged
defects.observed: stock 10, restock('pen', -5) returned 5 instead of rejecting
